scene_identity_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=false, and the train-corpus-v5 default ensure_ascii=true encoding
annotation_foreign_keys: marker candidates join the classifier typed id marker:<marker_uuid>; classifier source_id is only the raw UUID
overlay_panel_identity: overlay panel id is checked against matching native scene and annotation panel ids, not the independently imported production panel id
positive_requirements: candidate center has exactly one marker match and that marker has exactly one candidate match
marker id and connected or isolated subtype agree with the train annotation classifier
candidate has no 2px match to any annotated legend glyph
wide context crop does not intersect the synthetic overlay glyph or cue box
legend_symbol_requirements: candidate and annotation glyph are mutual unique within 2px
rendered and ablated RGB hashes differ and visible_changed_pixels is positive
candidate glyph id and visibility proof hash equal the artifact report
exclusions: unmatched or ambiguous candidates remain unlabeled
generic overlay and cue context contamination blocks labels
an exact duplicated local and wide tensor pair blocks every labeled row that uses that pair; shared local views with different wide views remain distinct

overlay_contract.visible_cue: cue_box and cue_text=note required; box must be within source raster
overlay_contract.invisible_cue: cue_box and cue_text must both be null
overlay_contract.crop_contamination: expand wide crop bounds by one source pixel for bilinear sampler neighbor support

family_split.unit: scene ID grouped within declared family signature
family_split.required_class_coverage: both classes in both assigned partitions
family_split.if_signature_partition_succeeds: status=assigned_signature_partition_review_only; assign train and validation for review only; keep all training_eligible=false

proposed_next_data_target.family_split: 8 train families and 2 held-out validation families
proposed_next_data_target.class_coverage: both proposed labels in every family
proposed_next_data_target.qualification: measurable experiment target only, not product gate; family independence must be established from distinct rendering sources and asset/renderer fingerprints, not recipe-cell changes

limitations: This is a review-only label curation proposal, not dataset registration or training approval.
Current evidence has one generator family signature across 64 train scenes, so family-disjoint validation is blocked.
The glyph visibility audit is hash-bound but not rerendered here.
Raw sampler tensor parity with the production classifier factory and normalization is not established.
Scene-level grouping does not establish participant-level or study-level independence.
